lines.text: The writer's soul cleaves to the dust, and he asks God to teach him His statutes and strengthen him.
He asks to be removed from the path of deceit, and he has chosen the way of wisdom.
He runs in the path of God's commandments, and he asks God to turn his heart toward His testimonies.
He asks God to turn his eyes from worthless things, and he asks God to establish His word to produce sacrifices.
He says he will walk in freedom and will speak of God's testimonies before kings without shame.
